store_cancel.definition: intersection(A=post-gen users per style, B=store-cancel users); rate=intersection/post-gen users
store_cancel.note: ESTIMATE ONLY - intersection of 2 user sets: (A) post-gen users per style (DISTINCT GA4 users with aivideo_generate_successful[l] / aivideo_result_view for that style) with (B) store-cancel users (cancel_at in last 90d, DISTINCT userpsid - snapshot semantics). Rate = intersection / post-gen users of that style. Not causal - generating a style did not necessarily cause the cancel; users with multiple styles count toward each style. Monitoring table is an Adjust-attributed subset and carries no refunds signal. aivideo_result_back_click is only an in-app back press, NOT a subscription cancel, and is kept separately as a weak proxy.
